{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Drop QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Confirm they are removed
print(f"Remaining rows after removing QA orders: {len(sales_clean)}")"}
